messages.subject: Error message from SQL StoredProcedures
parts:
Hi,

How do we catch messages from SQL sprocs in shiny - R? 

If we call a storedprocedure from shiny through RJDBC and want to know if the data is updated, how can we achieve that.  Can you read output parameters value from SQL?

Ex: 
create procedure [dbo].[SPROC_UPDATE] (  @result INT OUTPUT )
select @result  =1
--
--
RAISEERROR('error description',16,1)


Trying to  display success message to user once a query is successfully executed. Can some one help me in this regard.?

Thanks,
Sam
